title: 17th Special Operations Squadron fly MC-130P to Support Japan Earthquake & Tsunami Relief
description: At Yokota Air Base, members from the 374th Airlift Wing and 353rd Special Operations Group work together to deliver supplies, equipment and personnel to Sendai airport and other nearby area to aid in the earthquake and tsunami relief effort in Japan. jpearthquake11
keywords: MC-130P, Sendai, jpearthquake11, 17th SOS, Kadena, Yokota
